title: No rare treat for a prince
literal_meaning: Is khaja an extraordinary treat for a king’s son?
explanation: Something impressive to one person may be ordinary to someone with easy access. The rhetorical question puts the proposed treat in perspective.
meaning_odia: ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଖଜା ବହୁତ ଲୋଭନୀୟ ହୋଇପାରେ, ହେଲେ ସହଜରେ ତାହା ପାଉଥିବା ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ସେତେ ବିଶେଷ ନୁହେଁ। ସମାନ ଜିନିଷକୁ ନେଇ ଆଗ୍ରହ କାହିଁକି ଅଲଗା ହୁଏ, ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ସେହି ତଫାତକୁ ଧରେ। ନିଜକୁ ଯାହା ସାଧାରଣ ଲାଗେ, ଆଉ ଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ତାହା ବଡ଼ ଆକର୍ଷଣ ହୋଇପାରେ।
usage_example: An experienced photographer is unlikely to be dazzled simply by being shown a camera. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Khaja remains the named sweet. The source gloss explains ready access; no particular prince or court incident is identified.
